resources.description_en: Official guidance for student and graduate online assessments, with full-time and internship overviews, coding preparation and practice links.

resources.name: Amazon 研究科学家面试准备
resources.description: 研究岗位的官方准备指南，涵盖技术交流、知识深度、实验设计、研究介绍与行为面试准备。
resources.description_en: Official research-role guidance covering technical discussions, depth of knowledge, experimental design, research presentations and behavioral preparation.

resources.name: Amazon SDE 技术面试主题与示例
resources.name_en: Amazon SDE technical interview topics and examples
resources.description: 官方技术主题清单与准备示例，涵盖编程、数据结构、算法、数据库、分布式系统及机器学习基础。
resources.description_en: Official preparation topics and examples for coding, data structures, algorithms, databases, distributed systems and machine learning fundamentals.

resources.name: Machine Learning Crash Course：机器学习基础
resources.name_en: Machine Learning Crash Course: ML fundamentals
resources.description: 通过回归、分类、数据处理、泛化、神经网络与大语言模型入门模块复习机器学习基础，配合交互可视化和练习检查理解。
resources.description_en: Review regression, classification, data, generalization, neural networks and introductory LLM concepts with interactive visualizations and exercises.

resources.name: CUDA 编程指南：GPU 编程模型
resources.name_en: CUDA Programming Guide: the GPU programming model
resources.description: 从 CUDA 编程模型开始，学习 GPU 内核、异步执行、内存与多 GPU 编程，理解深度学习框架背后的执行方式。
resources.description_en: Study the CUDA programming model, GPU kernels, asynchronous execution, memory and multi-GPU programming to understand execution beneath deep learning frameworks.

resources.name: FSDP 原理：分片训练与显存（2021）
resources.name_en: FSDP foundations: sharded training and memory (2021)
resources.description: 这篇 2021 年的工程文章介绍参数、梯度和优化器状态分片，以及 all-gather、reduce-scatter 和计算通信重叠，适合复习分布式训练原理。
resources.description_en: This 2021 engineering article explains sharding parameters, gradients and optimizer state, all-gather, reduce-scatter and overlapping communication with computation.

resources.name: 构建有效的 AI agents：工作流与工具
resources.name_en: Building Effective AI Agents: workflows and tools
resources.description: 理解预设工作流与自主 agent 的区别，学习提示链、路由、并行和工具使用，并思考任务效果、延迟、成本与系统复杂度之间的取舍。
resources.description_en: Compare predefined workflows with autonomous agents. Study prompt chaining, routing, parallelization and tool use alongside task quality, latency, cost and complexity tradeoffs.

resources.name: ZeRO 与 DeepSpeed：状态分片原理（2020）
resources.name_en: ZeRO and DeepSpeed: state partitioning foundations (2020)
resources.description: 这篇 2020 年的研究文章通过优化器状态、梯度和参数分片解释 ZeRO 的三个阶段，帮助复习分布式训练中的显存冗余与通信取舍。
resources.description_en: This 2020 research article explains the three ZeRO stages through optimizer-state, gradient and parameter partitioning, covering memory redundancy and communication tradeoffs.

resources.name: 推荐系统课程：召回、打分与重排
resources.name_en: Recommendation systems: retrieval, scoring and re-ranking
resources.description: 通过 Google 官方课程复习候选生成、协同过滤、用户与物品嵌入、矩阵分解，以及打分与重排中的新鲜度和多样性取舍。
resources.description_en: Review candidate generation, collaborative filtering, user and item embeddings, matrix factorization, scoring, and freshness and diversity in re-ranking through Google’s official course.

resources.name: 图神经网络入门：消息传递与邻域采样
resources.name_en: Graph neural networks: message passing and neighborhood sampling
resources.description: 从节点、边和消息传递开始，理解邻域聚合、GCN、GraphSAGE 的采样与归纳学习，并了解图推荐和过平滑等应用与限制。
resources.description_en: Start with nodes, edges and message passing. Explore neighborhood aggregation, GCN, GraphSAGE sampling and inductive learning, graph recommendations and over-smoothing.

resources.name: TensorRT-LLM：注意力阶段与 KV cache
resources.name_en: TensorRT-LLM: attention phases and KV caches
resources.description: 结合 NVIDIA 官方文档区分上下文与逐 token 生成，阅读 MHA、MQA、GQA、分块注意力、连续与分页 KV cache 的实现思路。
resources.description_en: Use NVIDIA’s official documentation to distinguish context and token generation, and study MHA, MQA, GQA, tiled attention, and contiguous versus paged KV caches.

resources.name: Llama 3 历史参考源码：RMSNorm、RoPE 与 KV 头共享
resources.name_en: Llama 3 historical reference: RMSNorm, RoPE and KV head sharing
resources.description: 对照 Meta 的 2024 年参考实现阅读归一化、旋转位置编码、KV 头重复与缓存写入。仓库已归档，链接固定到历史提交，适合源码学习。
resources.description_en: Read normalization, rotary positions, KV head repetition and cache updates in Meta’s 2024 reference implementation. The repository is archived; this source-reading link pins the historical revision.

resources.name: Google GAN 课程：对抗损失与交替训练
resources.name_en: Google GAN course: adversarial losses and alternating training
resources.description: 通过 Google 官方课程复习生成器与判别器、交替训练、minimax 与非饱和目标，并思考如何判断训练状态。
resources.description_en: Review generators, discriminators, alternating training, minimax and non-saturating objectives, and training diagnostics through Google’s official course.

resources.name: TensorFlow 官方 VAE 教程：重参数化与 ELBO
resources.name_en: TensorFlow VAE tutorial: reparameterization and ELBO
resources.description: 对照 TensorFlow 官方卷积 VAE 教程阅读高斯后验、重参数化、Bernoulli 重建项与蒙特卡洛 ELBO 估计。
resources.description_en: Read Gaussian posteriors, reparameterization, Bernoulli reconstruction and Monte Carlo ELBO estimation in TensorFlow’s official convolutional VAE tutorial.

resources.name: Hugging Face 官方招聘入口
resources.description: 从 Hugging Face 官方网站链接进入招聘页，核对岗位职责、工作地点与申请条件；职位信息以原站为准。
resources.description_en: Follow the careers destination linked by Hugging Face’s official website. Review role requirements, locations and application details on the original site.

resources.name: 扩散模型入门：从玩具去噪到 DDPM
resources.name_en: Diffusion fundamentals: from toy denoising to DDPM
resources.description: 通过 Hugging Face 官方课程比较玩具扰动与 DDPM 噪声日程、干净样本与噪声预测目标，以及训练和采样的不同角色。
resources.description_en: Compare toy corruption with DDPM noise schedules, clean-sample and noise-prediction objectives, and the different roles of training and sampling in Hugging Face’s official course.

resources.name: Diffusers DDIM：预测约定、时间步与随机性
resources.name_en: Diffusers DDIM: prediction types, timesteps and stochasticity
resources.description: 阅读 Hugging Face 官方 DDIMScheduler 文档，核对预测类型、训练与推理时间步、eta、显式方差噪声及干净终点选项。
resources.description_en: Read the official DDIMScheduler reference for prediction types, training and inference timesteps, eta, explicit variance noise and the clean-endpoint option.

resources.name: LoRA 原始论文：冻结基座与低秩更新
resources.name_en: LoRA original paper: frozen weights and low-rank updates
resources.description: 微软研究院论文页，介绍冻结预训练权重与可训练低秩分解，结合第 14 题练习缩放更新与独立线性层。
resources.description_en: Microsoft Research publication page on frozen pretrained weights and trainable low-rank factors. Use module 14 to study scaled updates and an isolated linear layer.

resources.name: QLoRA 原理（2023）：NF4 与可训练 Adapter
resources.name_en: QLoRA foundations (2023): NF4 and trainable adapters
resources.description: Hugging Face 的 2023 年原理文章，区分 4-bit 权重存储、计算精度与可训练 Adapter；结合第 15 题理解 NF4 分块与冻结量化基座。
resources.description_en: A 2023 Hugging Face introduction distinguishing 4-bit weight storage, compute precision and trainable adapters. Use module 15 for NF4 blocks and a frozen quantized base.

paths.name: LLM 训练与生成入门
paths.description: 从下一词预测和回答掩码，练到候选分布、梯度累积与全局裁剪。
paths.description_en: Practice next-token targets, response masks, candidate distributions, gradient accumulation and global clipping.

paths.name: 生成、对话与持续学习基础
paths.description: 从核采样和下一词目标，练到多轮回答掩码、策略目标、参数保留与任务评估。
paths.description_en: Connect nucleus sampling and next-token targets with multi-turn response masks, policy objectives, parameter retention and task evaluation.

paths.name: 大模型算法准备
paths.description: 从注意力与归一化，到高效微调和偏好优化。
paths.description_en: From attention and normalization to efficient fine-tuning and preference optimization.

paths.name: 策略优化与后训练
paths.description: 从 GAE 优势估计，练到 PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO、DAPO 与 GSPO 的筛选、归一化和截断，再比较 DPO。
paths.description_en: Connect GAE advantages with PPO, GRPO, Dr. GRPO, DAPO and GSPO filtering, normalization and clipping, then compare DPO.

paths.name: Transformer 核心与效率
paths.description: 从位置编码与逐 token 变换，练到归一化、KV 头共享与在线 softmax。
paths.description_en: Practice positions, per-token transforms and normalization, then KV head sharing and online softmax.

paths.name: 归一化基础
paths.description: 从逐 token 的 LayerNorm、不去均值的 RMSNorm，练到样本内分组统计与梯度耦合。
paths.description_en: Compare token-local LayerNorm, uncentered RMSNorm and per-sample grouped moments, including gradient coupling.

paths.name: 推荐与检索准备
paths.description: 梳理排序目标、序列推荐、图协同过滤和向量检索。
paths.description_en: Review ranking objectives, sequential recommendation, graph collaborative filtering and retrieval.

paths.name: 训练与实验基础
paths.description: 从优化器、扩散调度与预测参数化，练到 DDPM / DDIM 采样、流匹配和策略优化。
paths.description_en: Practice optimizers, diffusion schedules and prediction targets, then DDPM/DDIM sampling, flow matching and policy optimization.

paths.name: 表征与对比学习
paths.description: 从图文对齐、当前 batch 对比与历史队列，走到特征去冗余和掩码潜在预测。
paths.description_en: Move from paired image-text alignment, in-batch contrast and historical queues to feature regularization and masked latent prediction.

paths.name: 少步生成与蒸馏
paths.description: 从 DDIM 走到两步压一步、一致性、平均速度和分布匹配。
paths.description_en: From DDIM to progressive distillation, consistency, MeanFlow and distribution matching.

paths.name: 潜在世界模型与规划
paths.description: 从 I-JEPA 的表征预测，练到对象轨迹遮蔽、联合下一状态预测与潜在空间 CEM 规划。
paths.description_en: Connect I-JEPA representation prediction, object trajectory masking, joint next-state learning and latent-space CEM planning.

paths.name: 表征对齐与分布正则
paths.description: 从 VICReg 统计约束、SIGReg / VISReg 分布正则与 REPA 逐 patch 对齐，走到 MoGe 的尺度和 z 轴平移约束。
paths.description_en: Compare VICReg statistics, SIGReg/VISReg distribution regularization and REPA patch alignment, then MoGe scale and camera-z shift constraints.

paths.name: 策略蒸馏与上下文对齐
paths.description: 从有效 token 损失掩码，练到学生前缀采样、双上下文因果对齐和逐词表项散度截断。
paths.description_en: Connect valid-token loss masks, student-prefix sampling, dual-context causal alignment and vocabulary-wise divergence clipping.

paths.name: 视觉量化与下一尺度生成
paths.description: 区分量化训练的替代梯度与冻结 tokenizer，练习残差码本、累计重建和尺度级信息流。
paths.description_en: Separate quantization-training surrogate gradients from a frozen tokenizer, then practice residual codes, cumulative reconstruction and scale-level information flow.

paths.name: 反馈与分布蒸馏
paths.description: 从成功解与环境反馈的路由，练到学生 Top-K 的尾部概率，再比较不同回答来源的非对称蒸馏目标。
paths.description_en: Connect solution and environment-feedback routing, student Top-K tail probability and asymmetric distillation across distinct response sources.

paths.name: 进阶架构与稳定性
paths.description: 从双图差分与逐通道记忆，练到沿深度检索，再比较逐 token 前馈与平滑有界激活。
paths.description_en: Compare two-map attention and channel-wise memory, retrieve across depth, then connect per-token feed-forward layers with smooth bounded activations.

paths.name: 离策略纠偏与 Pass@k
paths.description: 从 PPO 与组内优势出发，比较序列与 token 重要性权重，再实现多次采样的最大收益目标。
paths.description_en: Connect PPO and grouped advantages with sequence/token importance weights, then optimize the best reward from multiple samples.

paths.name: 生成目标与梯度
paths.description: 从旋转参数化与连续路径，比较预测空间、冻结漂移目标、正负流匹配与总体分布损失。
paths.description_en: Connect rotation parameterization and continuous paths with prediction spaces, frozen drifting targets, positive/negative flow matching and population-distribution losses.

paths.name: 低秩适配与量化
paths.description: 从冻结基座上的低秩更新，练到 NF4 重建，再比较平滑、截断 SVD 与残差量化。
paths.description_en: Practice low-rank updates on a frozen base and NF4 reconstruction, then compare smoothing, truncated SVD and residual quantization.

paths.name: 语言生成与分块掩码
paths.description: 连接下一词目标、有效回答掩码与注意力，再检查噪声和干净双流的块级可见性。
paths.description_en: Connect next-token objectives, response masks and attention, then inspect block visibility between noisy and clean token streams.

paths.name: 扩散采样与观测约束
paths.description: 从噪声调度和预测参数化，练到反向采样，再比较 DAPS 的干净空间校正与独立重加噪。
paths.description_en: Practice noise schedules, prediction parameterization and reverse sampling, then compare DAPS clean-space correction and independent renoising.

paths.name: 视觉与变分生成基础
paths.description: 从残差路径和批统计量，练到可微采样与变分生成目标。
paths.description_en: Connect residual paths and batch statistics with differentiable sampling and variational generation.

paths.name: 学习目标与随机正则化
paths.description: 从掩码词预测和对抗学习，理解监督目标、梯度归属与随机激活。
paths.description_en: Connect masked prediction and adversarial learning with target construction, gradient ownership and random activations.

paths.name: 自演化
paths.description: 沿出题、反馈、课程筛选和视觉渲染理解模型如何自演化。
paths.description_en: Follow task generation, feedback, curriculum filtering and visual rendering through self-evolution.

paths.name: 网络生物学
paths.description: 从互作图的度分布走到中心性、连通性、最短路径、前馈环和社区，练习可复现的网络分析。
paths.description_en: Study degree distributions, centrality, connectivity, shortest paths, feed-forward loops and communities through reproducible network analysis.
